concept_uz: 21-oktabrdagi «Kichkina qayiq» videosining javobi: 13 marta. Sirri — «moki»: bolalar oʻtadi, bitta bola qaytadi, katta oʻtadi, ikkinchi bola qaytadi. Bu toʻrt oʻtish bitta kattani oʻtkazadi: 3 × 4 + 1 = 13. Oldingi videodagi R1–R5 rasmlar saqlangan boʻlsa, qayta ishlating.

facts.claim: Jasur 40 + Afsona 36 = 76 kg — bolalar birga sigʻadi
1: bolalar birga oʻtadi; 2: Afsona qaytadi; 3: bobo yolgʻiz oʻtadi; 4: Jasur qaytadi — ikki bola yana boshlangʻich qirgʻoqda
Bu toʻrt oʻtish dada uchun (5–8) va oyi uchun (9–12) takrorlanadi; oxirida bolalar birga oʻtadi — 13
Nega kam emas: katta doim yolgʻiz oʻtadi, qayiqni katta qaytarsa suzishi behuda; har katta 4 oʻtish; 3 × 4 + 1 = 13
Sirri: moki — avvalgi holatga qaytaradigan, lekin bitta ishni bajaradigan takroriy harakat
Raund 3: 2026-10-19 ochilgan, javobi 2026-10-26 da ochildi — bugun (2026-10-28) javob videosi ruxsat; savol videosi 2026-10-21 da Jonibekka ketgan (№61)

style_line: Cinematic photoreal, crisp clear mountain morning, cold turquoise river, golden autumn poplars, 35mm film look, warm family-adventure mood. No text, no letters, no watermark.

refs.name_uz: Muhit: togʻ daryosi va qayiq (21-oktabr videosidagi rasm)
refs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 wide shot of a fast clear turquoise mountain river between pebble banks, snowy peaks and golden poplars behind. On the near bank a very small old wooden rowing boat with two oars is pulled onto the pebbles. The far bank with a footpath is clearly visible. No people, no signs.

Left to right: a big broad grandfather of about 70 with a white beard and a dark BLUE skullcap; a tall father of about 40 in a GREY fleece jacket; a mother of about 38 with a RED scarf around her neck and a hiking backpack; a skinny 12-year-old boy in an ORANGE hoodie; a small 10-year-old girl with two braids and a PURPLE raincoat. Hiking clothes, no logos.

Change the moment: the big grandfather in the dark blue skullcap now sits alone in the little boat at the water's edge, the boat pressed deep into the water with the rim just above the surface; the rest of the family stands on the bank watching with wide eyes. Same faces, same clothes, same light, 9:16.

lines.text: Javob: oʻn uch marta. Bundan kam boʻlmaydi. Qanday qilib? Koʻring.

scenes.prompt: The frozen family on the bank comes back to life with one bright bell ring: the splash of water in the air falls, everyone blinks and turns to the boat. Fast push-in. Audio: a bell, then the river rushes again. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, warm middle-aged male storyteller voice: "Javob: o'n uch marta. Bundan kam bo'lmaydi. Qanday qilib? Ko'ring." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Men oʻttiz olti, akam qirq. Ikkalamiz — yetmish olti!

scenes.prompt: The girl in the purple raincoat grabs her brother by the sleeve and points at the boat, the boy nods eagerly. Audio: a light playful plink, the river. Afsona says in Uzbek with a confident, playful voice of a 10-year-old girl: "Men o'ttiz olti, akam qirq. Ikkalamiz — yetmish olti!" Jasur says in Uzbek with an eager, bright voice of a 12-year-old boy: "Demak, biz birga sig'amiz!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Bir: bolalar birga oʻtadi. Ikki: Afsona qayiqni qaytarib keladi.

scenes.prompt: The two children row together across the river and land on the far bank; then the girl jumps back into the boat alone and rows back towards the family. Audio: oars splashing, children laughing. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, warm middle-aged male storyteller voice: "Bir: bolalar birga o'tadi. Ikki: Afsona qayiqni qaytarib keladi." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Uch: bobo yolgʻiz oʻtadi. Toʻrt: Jasur qayiqni qaytaradi.

scenes.prompt: The grandfather rows alone across the river, the low boat creaking, and steps out onto the far bank; the boy in the orange hoodie hops in and rows back towards the near bank. Audio: wooden creak, splashing oars, a happy grunt. The grandfather says in Uzbek with a deep, slow, good-humoured voice of a 70-year-old man: "Yetib keldim!" An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, warm middle-aged male storyteller voice: "Uch: bobo yolg'iz o'tadi. To'rt: Jasur qayiqni qaytaradi." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

On the near bank the two children stand side by side by the boat again, high-five each other and look at their father with a cheeky grin. Audio: a high-five slap, the river. Jasur says in Uzbek with an eager, bright voice of a 12-year-old boy: "Ikkalamiz yana shu qirg'oqdamiz!" Afsona says in Uzbek with a confident, playful voice of a 10-year-old girl: "Lekin bobo endi narida!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Toʻrt oʻtish — bitta katta odam. Dada uchun yana toʻrtta, oyi uchun yana toʻrtta. Hammasi oʻn ikki.

scenes.prompt: Quick montage on the same river: the children cross together, one comes back, the father rows alone, the other child comes back; then the same again with the mother rowing alone. Speeded-up, playful rhythm. Audio: a ticking metronome and splashing oars. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, warm middle-aged male storyteller voice: "To'rt o'tish — bitta katta odam. Dada uchun yana to'rtta, oyi uchun yana to'rtta. Hammasi o'n ikki." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Oʻn uch: bolalar oxirgi marta birga oʻtadi. Hamma narigi qirgʻoqda!

scenes.prompt: The two children row together one last time and land on the far bank, where the whole family runs to hug them; the grandfather lifts the girl onto his shoulders. Audio: oars, then cheering and laughter. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, warm middle-aged male storyteller voice: "O'n uch: bolalar oxirgi marta birga o'tadi. Hamma narigi qirg'oqda!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Katta odam qayiqni qaytarsa, suzgani behuda ketadi.
Shuning uchun har birimizga toʻrtta oʻtish: uch karra toʻrt, yana bitta — oʻn uch.

scenes.prompt: The grandfather, with the girl on his shoulders, wags a finger wisely at the camera; the father nods beside him. Audio: the river, a warm low cello note. The grandfather says in Uzbek with a deep, slow, good-humoured voice of a 70-year-old man: "Katta odam qayiqni qaytarsa, suzgani behuda ketadi." The father says in Uzbek with a steady, slightly worried voice of a 40-year-old man: "Shuning uchun har birimizga to'rtta o'tish: uch karra to'rt, yana bitta — o'n uch." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Sirri: mokini toping — boshiga qaytaradigan, lekin bitta ishni bajaradigan harakat. Siz topdingizmi? Izohda yozing!

scenes.prompt: Slow pull-back and rise above the river: the family small on the far bank, the little boat resting on the pebbles, the mountains glowing in the sun. Audio: a final soft bell, wind. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, warm middle-aged male storyteller voice: "Sirri: mokini toping — boshiga qaytaradigan, lekin bitta ishni bajaradigan harakat. Siz topdingizmi? Izohda yozing!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.
